title: 🎦 Marvdasht Residents Gather at Persepolis to Protest Rubio's Statements and Support Iranian Civilization
text:
🎦 Marvdasht Residents Gather at Persepolis to Protest Rubio's Statements and Support Iranian Civilization"

"🔹People from Marvdasht gathered at the historical complex of Persepolis to protest Rubio's remarks and to defend Iranian identity and civilization.
